provenance.construction: Recursive 25-qubit Clifford/stabilizer-row-space reduction of codes/924-18-31.json, continuing through the merged codes/920-18-31.json parent. At each one-qubit step, a low-weight row-space stabilizer S is substituted into a generating set, its selected qubit is cleared from the remaining same-type checks, a CNOT fan-out disentangles that qubit, and the qubit is deleted. The 21 new steps below codes/920-18-31.json were generated by enumerating connected sums of at most three checks, accepting only candidates that preserve k=18, maximum check weight 8, the inherited local-2d-bilayer layout, and interaction radius 4.242640687119285. Both logical witnesses were transformed through every Clifford step and remain valid at weight 31. This preserves a witness-backed upper bound only; it does not certify the minimum distance.

Recursive derivative of merged codes/920-18-31.json, not an independent construction. The original codes/924-18-31.json construction is credited to @e-eight. The merged parent reductions are credited to @dorakingx with Claude Opus 5 (Claude Code), and the codes/920-18-31.json contribution and this 21-step continuation to [[899,18,d<=31]] are credited to @DennisWayo with GPT-5 (Codex). The new chain preserves k=18, maximum check weight 8, local-2d-bilayer geometry, interaction radius 4.242640687119285, and transformed X/Z logical witnesses of weight 31 while deleting 21 additional physical qubits. Two independent CI-style fire passes used seeds 2026101501 and 2027101504. Each pass ran the structural detector, 132880 ordinary RIS trials, and 8000000 RIS-fast trials. Neither pass found a logical below weight 31; RIS-fast reached weight 31 in both passes. The combined post-reduction attack budget was 265760 ordinary RIS trials plus 16000000 RIS-fast trials. Distance remains an upper bound, not an exact claim, and literature novelty is unverified.
